name: geosilo_encode
description: Encode a GEOMETRY into the compact GEOSILO format. With one argument, scale is auto-detected from the geometry's CRS (or defaults to 1e7); with two, the second argument explicitly sets the integer scale.

name: geosilo_decode
description: Decode a GEOSILO blob back into GEOMETRY. Most callers don't need this — the implicit cast from GEOSILO to GEOMETRY runs it for any ST_* function that doesn't have a native GEOSILO overload.

name: geosilo_metadata
description: Read a GEOSILO blob's header without decoding the geometry. Returns `STRUCT(geometry_type, vertex_type, scale)` — useful for type filtering and schema inspection.
